subject: lina_dragon_slave
description_zh: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
description_en: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: lina_light_strike_array
description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
description_en: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

subject: lina_fiery_soul
description_zh: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续%fiery_soul_stack_duration%秒。
description_en: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

subject: lina_flame_cloak
description_zh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。
description_en: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

subject: lina_slow_burn
description_zh: 莉娜的技能会在%burn_duration%秒内额外造成%burn_damage_pct%%%原伤害的烧灼伤害。
description_en: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.

subject: lina_laguna_blade
description_zh: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
description_en: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
notes_zh: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。

shard.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
shard.en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

subject: lich_frost_nova
description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

subject: lich_frost_shield
description_zh: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
description_en: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes_zh: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。

subject: lich_sinister_gaze
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

scepter.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。
scepter.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

subject: lich_ice_spire
description_zh: 在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受%max_hero_attacks%次英雄攻击或%max_creep_attacks%次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
description_en: Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

subject: lich_death_charge
description_zh: 牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
description_en: Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

subject: lich_chain_frost
description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

subject: lion_impale
description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: lion_voodoo
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes_zh: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

subject: lion_mana_drain
description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。
shard.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.

subject: lion_to_hell_and_back
description_zh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供%debuff_amp%%%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续%duration%秒的%spell_amp%%%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。
description_en: Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

subject: lion_finger_of_death
description_zh: 撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
description_en: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。

scepter.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。
scepter.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

subject: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

subject: shadow_shaman_voodoo
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

subject: shadow_shaman_shackles
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。
scepter.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

subject: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

subject: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
description_zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的%megaward_multiplier_tooltip%倍，持续%ward_duration%秒。
description_en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

subject: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
description_zh: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
description_en: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

subject: slardar_sprint
description_zh: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初%speed_burst_max_duration%内斯拉达获得%slow_resistance_tooltip%%%减速抗性。减速抗性会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
description_en: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
notes_zh: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。

subject: slardar_slithereen_crush
description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

shard.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。
shard.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
